items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Charlie Cardilla is a patient of mine and I've gotten a great deal of material from him both in pictures and in interviews

ctx.x: prohibition times I guess it came up wasn't it

yes but it was clean but they had sawdust on the floor and they had sometimes sand on the floor you hear the dancers shuffling when they were dancing and I have a picture that I want to show you which is I'm going to use eventually in which I'll be glad to give you a copy after I've used it's the only interior shot I have ever seen well I got that and I remember the dance there only had four or five pieces and I didn't even know who the boys were then although what's his name Charlie Cardilla is a patient of mine…
down in the Irish Channel a pretty tough place
